units.source_text: "我们家附近有位特别标致的插花师傅，前些日子给我讲了一段悲伤的爱情故事。

en.t: Near our house there is an especially beautiful flower-arranging teacher, and the other day she told me a sad love story.

units.source_text: 战争期间，这位师傅已经有了心上人，是个陆军军官，眼看他即将开拔，两人便在南禅寺利用短暂的时间做临别前的会面。

en.t: During the war, this teacher already had a sweetheart, an army officer, and when his departure was imminent, the two of them used the brief time they had to meet at Nanzenji before parting.

units.source_text: 这对情侣没得到父母的承认，别离前女方却怀了孕，可怜的是胎儿死产。

en.t: The couple had not been accepted by their parents, and before they parted the woman became pregnant, but sadly the child was stillborn.

units.source_text: 这位军官非常悲伤，哀叹之余说：哪怕是一丁点儿，我也想喝喝作为母亲的你的奶汁。

en.t: The officer was deeply grieved, and in his lament he said, Even if it is only the tiniest bit, I want to drink the milk from you as a mother.

units.source_text: 据说因为时间紧迫，女方当场把奶汁挤在淡茶里让他喝了。

en.t: It is said that because time was short, the woman expressed her milk into thin tea right there and let him drink it.

units.source_text: 一个月后，她的情人战死了。

en.t: A month later, her lover was killed in battle.

units.source_text: 从此师傅一直坚持守寡，过着单身生活。

en.t: From then on, the teacher remained faithful as a widow and lived alone.

units.source_text: 尽管她还很年轻，长得又很艳美，可……"

en.t: Even though she was still very young and strikingly beautiful..."
